title: Business Central 2025 wave 1 (BC26.3): Automate payables processes with the Payables Agent
summary: The Payables Agent in Business Central 2025 wave 1 automates accounts payable tasks by extracting vendor invoices from email and SharePoint, creating purchase invoice drafts for review, and using purchase history to auto-fill document details. This feature reduces manual data entry and errors while freeing AP professionals for higher-value work.
key_points: Payables Agent sources vendor invoice attachments (PDF) from Microsoft 365 email and SharePoint, then imports them into E-Documents
The agent creates purchase invoice document drafts using past purchase history and company accounting policies for auto-population
Setup involves activating the agent, configuring email accounts, and choosing which invoice fields should be auto-filled
Feature is available in BC26.3 but currently limited to United States and United Kingdom regions

quotes.text: The agent sources vendor invoice attachments from email and SharePoint, and creates purchase invoice documents in Business Central for review.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core functionality of how the agent processes invoices

quotes.text: In the first version, the Payables Agent can source purchase attachments (PDF files) from a Microsoft 365 email account where vendors send their invoices.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the specific technical capability and supported file format in the initial release
